  (hB :

  (T : NNReal) (coeff : (level : ℕ) → Fin (2 ^ level) → kappa → Omega → ℝ)
  (hAdapted : ∀ (level : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ level)) (j : kappa), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (coeff level i j))

  have error := fun level omega =>
    have times :=
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
        (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T level)

        (∑ j, coeff level i j omega ^ 2) * ↑(times i.succ - times i.castSucc));

approved_definition_context: For B with values in a real Hilbert space E, AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsStandardBrownianMotion B μ means: B(0,ω)=0 for every ω; any finite family of increments over pairwise disjoint half-open intervals is jointly independent; for s<t every continuous linear real functional ℓ sends B(t)−B(s) to the centered real Gaussian with variance (t−s)‖ℓ‖²; and paths are continuous for μ-almost every ω.
